_: Section cards over the built-in packages' full instructions (mods/<id>/agent.md). `blocks` are 0-based blank-line-separated blocks of that file, inclusive; `heading` names a `## ` section. `when` is the one line an author writes for the index (system language). `trigger` says who decides the card is due: `jev` (judged from the player's words and the turn's context), `state` (a capsule field is present), `host` (a host event), `always` (resident; never indexed).

cards.when: A readable or writable physical carrier is in play: a letter, note, book, map, label, sign, photograph or handout is received, opened, read, written on, or the investigator writes something in the fiction.
cards.when_zh: 涉及可读写的实物载体：收到、打开、阅读、书写一封信、字条、书、地图、标签、照片或手卡，或调查员在剧情里写了什么。

cards.when: An item the investigator already owns but has never been registered is first drawn, shown, handed over, used in a check, damaged or lost; or this is the opening delivery.
cards.when_zh: 调查员已有但从未登记的物品第一次被拔出、出示、递出、用于检定、损坏或丢失；或这是开场交付。

cards.when: A new item, weapon or spell with a mechanical effect appears in the fiction: found, bought, picked up, given, made, or brought in by a person present.
cards.when_zh: 剧情里出现有机制效果的新物品、武器或法术：找到、买到、捡到、被赠予、制作，或由在场的人带来。

cards.when: An owned item changes hands, is used up, repaired, damaged, inspected, taken out of a container, thrown, or a registered spell is learned or cast.
cards.when_zh: 已登记的物品易手、用完、修理、损坏、查看、从容器取出、投掷，或学习、施放已登记的法术。

cards.when: The investigator attacks or uses force with a carried object or a scene object, including an improvised weapon or a vehicle part.
cards.when_zh: 调查员用随身物品或场景物件攻击或施力，包括临时武器或车辆部件。

cards.when: The host refused a narration for an undeclared mechanical object.
Every turn: carry the selected goal through what needs no choice; stop before a new one; give the public basis for the next judgment.
An outcome about to land could kill or gravely wound an investigator: a fight, a fall, a trap, a creature within reach, a vehicle at speed.
cards.when_zh: 即将落下的结果可能致死或重伤调查员：战斗、坠落、陷阱、近身的怪物、高速的车辆。

cards.when: The party spends real time, makes noise, is seen, or pushes a danger's own interest forward, while a threat clock is running in mods.pacing.
cards.when_zh: 队伍花了真实时间、弄出动静、被人看见，或推进了威胁自身的利益，而 mods.pacing 里有威胁钟在走。

cards.when: The player seems stuck: asks what to do, repeats the same low-agency action, or stalled_turns has reached the setting.
cards.when_zh: 玩家看起来卡住了：问该做什么、重复同一个低能动性的动作，或 stalled_turns 已到设定值。

cards.when: The player asks out of character, is unsure what their investigator already knows, asks for a reminder or help sorting their options, or the book calls for an Idea roll.
cards.when_zh: 玩家以场外身份提问、不确定调查员已经知道什么、要求提醒或帮忙理清选项，或书里要求灵感检定。

cards.when: The Director reads RECOVER: the last turn landed nothing or the player repeated their input.
Every turn: pacing is not an escalation ladder.

cards.heading: start
cards.when: The investigator makes first meaningful contact with a person they have not dealt with before: approaching, greeting, speaking to or being addressed by them.
cards.when_zh: 调查员与此前没打过交道的人第一次有实质接触：走近、打招呼、搭话，或被对方搭话。

cards.heading: Asking for something
cards.when: The investigator asks a person for something that person would have to grant: goods, work, a favour, a discount, access, a loan, a secret.
cards.when_zh: 调查员向某人索要对方得同意才能给的东西：货物、劳务、人情、折扣、准入、借款、秘密。

cards.heading: What the asker is after
cards.when: The investigator asks a person a question or seeks information from them: the way somewhere, a price, who someone is, what happened, whether they saw something.
cards.when_zh: 调查员向某人提问或打听：去处怎么走、价钱、某人是谁、发生了什么、有没有见过什么。

cards.heading: The language of the exchange
cards.when: The investigator speaks with a person whose language or fluency may differ from theirs, or a language gap is already established between them.
cards.when_zh: 调查员与语言或流利程度可能不同的人交谈，或双方之间已经确立了语言隔阂。

cards.when: The player's action could reach a clue of the module: searching, examining, reading, listening at a door, following a lead, or asking where to go next.
cards.when_zh: 玩家的行动可能触及模组线索：搜查、检视、阅读、隔门偷听、追一条线，或问下一步去哪。

cards.when: mods.thread.reentry is present.
Something the book plainly places in the room is in front of the investigator, or a present person is asked what they know about the case.
cards.when_zh: 书里明写放在这房间里的东西就在调查员面前，或在场的人被问起对案子知道些什么。

cards.when: The player tries to connect evidence, draw a conclusion, asks what the clues mean, or turns an abbreviated clue into testimony.
cards.when_zh: 玩家试图把证据串起来、下结论、问这些线索意味着什么，或把一条简写线索当证词讲出来。

cards.heading: This turn
cards.when: Every turn.

cards.heading: Sentences and paragraphs
cards.when: Every turn.

cards.heading: The people here
cards.when: Every turn with a person present.

cards.heading: Scene and detail
cards.when: Every turn.

cards.heading: Opening the table
cards.when: The opening turn.

cards.heading: Settings
cards.when: Every turn.
historical_reference_materials were handed to this step, or a specific period detail those excerpts lack is needed.
Every turn: references never override delivered fiction or source truth.
A price, wage, fare, rent, menu or cost of goods comes up: buying, paying, ordering, renting a room, hiring someone, being quoted a sum.
cards.when_zh: 出现价格、工钱、车费、房租、菜单或货物价钱：买东西、付钱、点餐、租房、雇人、被报价。

cards.when: The player disputes or challenges a price that was quoted to them as wrong for the period or place.
cards.when_zh: 玩家对报给他的价格提出异议，认为不符合那个年代或地方。

cards.when: Historical retrieval is closed for this input.
A workspace was provided.
Every turn on a table played in Chinese.
